name: Stubborn Seed
dinnerNoteZh: 九道菜品嚐套餐（六道菜套餐150美元）

menus.name: Nine-course tasting menu
menus.note: Changes with the seasons; black truffles ($40) and caviar ($45 or $90) can be added.

alsoTry.name: The bar
alsoTry.note: Serves an à la carte menu (dishes about $17–$31, fish $75) as well as the tasting menus.

bookingOpens: Online through SevenRooms, from the restaurant's website. Bookings are strongly encouraged.
cancellation: Cancelling within 24 hours of the booking costs $50 a person, or $100 a person on holidays and special occasions.
groups: A 20% gratuity is added for parties of six or more. The whole restaurant can be booked for up to 65 seated or 100 standing guests.
